Finding: campaign hour is not reserved anywhere
Evidence: The 4896xxx batch, 16 posts, is placed at 22:15 facebook, 22:30 instagram, 22:45 youtube, 23:30 instagram and 23:45 tiktok on 10/01, 10/03 and 10/05. The loader holds 23:00 and 23:30 for the campaign on those same nights and accounts. Every one of the 4 channels collides: facebook 75 minutes, instagram 30 both sides, youtube 45, tiktok 45.
Why: halloween-33/load.py puts the nightly post at 23:00 on instagram and tiktok and 23:30 on facebook and youtube, every night for 33 nights. Nothing in the repo says those slots are taken, so any other scheduler is free to place into them and keeps doing it. This is why the real C05 count has climbed every night this week: 6, then 8, then 9, now 17. It is not drift, it is 2 schedulers competing for the same hour with no record of who owns it. The missing data is a slot reservation: which times on which accounts belong to a live campaign, for the length of its run. With that, a gate can refuse a post that lands in a reserved slot, and the other scheduler has somewhere to look before it places.
Fix: propose a reservations CSV plus a gate rule. Not built, it changes a merged gate and needs Amanda.
